info.title: Junction Rocket API
info.description:
This API follows the [JSON:API][jsonapi] specification.

A recommended booking flow example:

1. Create search request.
2. Get search results
3. Create quote
4. Create a booking

tags.description: TODO: To search for flights, you'll need to create an air search request. An air search request describes the passengers and where and when they want to travel.

tags.name: hotel-searches
tags.description: TODO: To search for hotels, you'll need to create a hotel search request. A hotel search request describes the passengers and where and when they want to stay.

tags.name: places
tags.description: To search within any Junction vertical, you need at least one place to travel to, usually also a place to travel from! Our Places endpoint allows you to find these locations and identify which verticals you can search with them.

Coordinates.description: A Coordinate represented via latitude and longitude

status.description: The HTTP status code applicable to this problem, expressed as a string value.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem that SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem. Like `title`, this field’s value can be localized.

code.description: An application-specific error code, expressed as a string value.

source.description: An object containing references to the source of the error.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer to the associated entity in the request document.

parameter.description: A string indicating which URI query parameter caused the error.

header.description: A string indicating the name of a single request header which caused the error.

expiresAt.description: The time at which the object will expire in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format

status.description: The status of the Rail Search

passengers.description: The list of passengers that will travel on the requested rail search

selectedOutboundOffer.description: The selected outbound Offer ID for use when performing the inbound search on a roundtrip. Not required for one-way scenarios
